newsitem.title: CHINA: China forex market volume hits year high in June.
newsitem.headline: China forex market volume hits year high in June.

text.p: Trading volume on the China Foreign Exchange Trade System was equivalent to $6.41 billion in June, up from $5.864 billion in May and the highest monthly turnover in 1997, China Securities News said on Monday.
Average daily turnover on the Shanghai-based interbank market was equivalent to $300 million, up nine percent over May, the newspaper said.
The yuan strengthened against the dollar, rising to 8.2907 on June 28, from 8.2921 on May 30, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
The Chinese currency also strengthened against the Hong Kong dollar to end June at 1.0691 against 1.0708 at the end of May, it said.
But the yen rose against the yuan on the Shanghai market thanks to a good performance against the dollar on the world market, it said.
The yuan closed at 7.2379 to 100 yen on June 28 against 7.1182 at the end of May, it said.
